tool.name: orthologer
tool.command:
export BUSCO_DATA='' && #if $test == 'true' export MAP_ORTHODB_DATA='' && #else export MAP_ORTHODB_DATA='$cached_ortodb_db.fields.path' && #end if ## creates environment and config file ## -L -> maximum nr of processes in parallel orthologer -f -c create -L "\${GALAXY_SLOTS}" &&
## copy input fasta touch orthology_import.txt &&
#import os #for $fasta in $fsfiles: #set $label=os.path.basename($fasta.element_identifier) echo '+$label' '$fasta' >> orthology_import.txt && #end for
## import fasta files and set project label ./orthologer.sh manage -f orthology_import.txt &&
## ensure the config file is conform ./orthologer.sh -t todo/orthology_import.todo -u &&
## run orthology echo "===> START RUN" && ./orthologer.sh -r all && echo "===> END OF RUN" &&
## create result #if $test == 'true' grep -e HSAPI:cjt2n4 -e MMULA:7m0hxx Cluster/orthology_import.og_map | awk '{print$2,$3}' | sort > orthology.txt #else grep -v '^#' Cluster/orthology_import.og_map > orthology.txt #end if

validator.message: No OrthoDB data is available - please contact your Galaxy admin.

tool.help:
Orthologer computes orthology among a set of proteoms as given by fasta files.
.. class:: warningmark
The orthologer tool provided here is a simple wrapper to the tool described at https://orthologer.ezlab.org . It provides more configuration options to job scheduling and algorithmic parameters (alignment, BRH finding, clustering etc).
**Input data**
- A set of FASTA files with protein sequences. Each FASTA file represents one species.
**Output**
- The computed orthology.
